Practised distinguishing observation, hypothesis, law and theory.
Tara identified hypotheses as testable predictions and observations as descriptions of what happens.
They identified a law and described theory as an evidence-supported explanation.

end.parentNote: Tara practised sorting statements as observations, hypotheses, laws and theories. They used the idea of a testable prediction and noted that conditions should stay the same, such as using the same type of milk or equal heating. Tara mixed up a hypothesis with a lower boiling temperature statement; this was not clearly corrected in the lesson. At home, ask Tara to label one everyday statement of each type and explain why it fits.
